title: Add explicit permissions to GitHub Actions workflows to fix CodeQL warnings
change_proposed: Add a top-level `permissions: contents: read` block to 13 GitHub Actions workflows, and to the yml generator sources, to clear CodeQL missing-permissions warnings.
what_landed: #3826 (merged 2025-12-01, about 5 months later, approved by kennykerr, the maintainer who closed #3648) added the same `permissions: contents: read` block to the same 13 workflows plus publish.yml; no generator change was needed because #3820 had made the yml tool keep each file's header.
closed_reason: Maintainer closed it as unnecessary because the default token permissions were already read-only. He also asked for the Clippy fix to go in a separate PR.

title: fix: update express and path-to-regexp dependencies
change_proposed: Bump express from 4.21.1 to 4.21.2 and path-to-regexp from 0.1.10 to 0.1.12 in package-lock.json, fixing the path-to-regexp ReDoS that npm audit flagged, and raise server/package.json's express range to ^4.21.2.
what_landed: Commit d007f92302 ('Update deps', merged to main on 2025-02-19 in #136) made the same lockfile bump to express 4.21.2 and path-to-regexp 0.1.12. The ^4.21.2 range was never adopted; instead the server moved to express ^5.1.0 on 2025-04-16.
closed_reason: Devin auto-closed it for inactivity after the reviewer asked for package.json to be updated too.

title: Add additional URI options tests
change_proposed: Add URI-options spec tests for timeoutMS, for serverMonitoringMode with SRV URIs and for proxy options with SRV URIs to connection-options, sdam-options and proxy-options test files.
what_landed: Nothing: source/uri-options had no commits between 2024-10-31 and 2026-03-05, the timeoutMS URI tests the PR added already existed (hence 'duplicate'), and today's proxy-options/sdam-options files still have no mongodb+srv tests.
closed_reason: Requester and reviewer JamesKovacs asked to merge the tests into existing files, drop tests that duplicated ones already there and drop JSON without YAML, then closed it himself without giving a further reason.

title: Fix: Custom tags defined as floats being treated as strings in smart playlists
change_proposed: Make smart-playlist comparisons on float and int custom tags numeric. A new tag-type registry in model/criteria (RegisterTagType, filled from the tag mappings by the model package) would drive a CAST(value AS REAL) or CAST(value AS INTEGER) in tagCond.ToSql().
what_landed: Maintainer deluan's #4116 (merged 2025-05-25, fixing #4055) solved the same problem a different way. The model package calls AddNumericTags(numericTagNames()) to set a numeric flag on the existing criteria fieldMap, and both integer and float tags are cast AS REAL, in sorting as well as comparisons.
closed_reason: The maintainer closed it the moment he opened his own fix, #4116, with no closing comment.

title: Implement Admin-Only Log Viewer in UI
change_proposed: Add an admin-only real-time log viewer: a logrus hook feeding a 1000-entry ring buffer, a new server/admin SSE endpoint /api/admin/logs/stream that receives middleware as parameters to avoid an import cycle, and a react-window virtualized LogViewer UI.
what_landed: Nothing: no commits added a log buffer, admin log stream or LogViewer during the 180 days. Today's tree has no ringbuffer, buffer_hook, server/admin or LogViewer files, and ui/package.json has no react-window.
closed_reason: Closed by maintainer deluan without comment after repeated CI, lint and test failures. Review had asked for Ginkgo tests and to reuse the existing server/events SSE package instead of a new endpoint.

title: Deprecate CongestionControl feature
change_proposed: Deprecate the CongestionControl protocol feature: rename it to _DeprecatedCongestionControl with #[deprecated], remove its .enabled() checks and CONGESTION_CONTROL_VERSION, make congestion_info non-optional (including ChunkExtra::new always building V3), delete pre-feature tests and remove now-unused parameters.
what_landed: #13318 (same requester, Devin, merged 2025-04-08 on fresh master) did the rename, #[deprecated], check and constant removal, unused-parameter removal and many Option<CongestionInfo> to CongestionInfo changes (chunk headers, getters, kv_runtime get_congestion_info). Maintainer PR #13305 resolved the genesis blocker by building prod genesis chunk extra as ChunkExtraV2, so ChunkExtra::new kept an Option<CongestionInfo> parameter and a V2 fallback.
closed_reason: Superseded by #13318 'which has the latest changes on master'; the reviewer had blocked this one on saving the genesis chunk extra.

title: fix(ignore-list): skip star pattern
change_proposed: Skip a bare '*' entry (after trimming) in ExcludedFiles::addManualExclude and loadExcludeFilePatterns in src/csync/csync_exclude.cpp so a lone '*' ignore pattern no longer stops all sync, with the test flipped to expect '*' not to exclude.
what_landed: Maintainer mgallien's replacement PR #8466 (merged 2025-07-18) carries the same commit plus his two review fixups (QStringView instead of QLatin1StringView for trimming the QString, and dropping an unneeded variable reuse); the star-skip is still on master today.
closed_reason: Replaced by #8466 (same commit re-opened by the maintainer with his review suggestions applied).

title: Fix UN space objects dataset description: change creation year from 1962 to 1900
change_proposed: Change the UN space-objects metadata text from 'since 1962' to 'since 1900' in the fasttrack and space snapshot/grapher metadata files.
closed_reason: Maintainer: 'Actually we won't do this'; issue #4650 was a 'COPILOT TEST' closed as not planned. master still says 'since 1962' (snapshots/space/2025-03-04/object_launches.csv.dvc), so the 'keep 1962' claims match the code.

change_proposed: Add a new Vite/React/MUI dashboard in new-dashboard/ with a Cloud Config page, serve its build from Express at /new in Parse-Dashboard/app.js, and add a sidebar link to it.
what_landed: Nothing landed: no new-dashboard directory or /new route was added. The app.js commits in the next 180 days are unrelated (#2880, #2920, #2954, #3011, #3016).
closed_reason: Closed the same day by maintainer mtrezza without comment; CodeRabbit had flagged lint failures and client-side master-key use.

title: Add graph visualization for selected numbers
change_proposed: Add a resizable GraphPanel side panel to the Data Browser that charts the selected numeric or time-series cells with the existing Chart component, toggled from the stats toolbar.
what_landed: Only related work: the maintainer's PR #3110 (merged 2026-01-13) added a different 'Data Graphs' feature. It is a resizable GraphPanel configured through a GraphDialog that charts the loaded rows with Chart.js, with data shaping in lib/GraphDataUtils.js. It does not graph selected cells and does not index ChartColorSchemes.
closed_reason: Closed by the maintainer (mtrezza) without comment. The only review came from CodeRabbit.

title: Migrate CounterLabel component tests from Jest to Vitest
change_proposed: Migrate CounterLabel.test.tsx from Jest to Vitest (vitest imports, drop behavesAsComponent/checkExports/axe, import from './CounterLabel', plain render), adding CounterLabel to the vitest include list and to Jest's modulePathIgnorePatterns.
what_landed: Maintainer joshblack's #6348 (merged 2025-07-24) migrated the CounterLabel tests to Vitest: vitest imports, behavesAsComponent/checkExports/axe dropped, the vitest browser include entry and Jest ignore entry added. It kept the '..' import and the HTMLRender alias and replaced the snapshots with assertions.
closed_reason: No closing comment; closed a day after Copilot addressed review (re-enable browser mode, drop the IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT global). The maintainer migrated it in #6348.

title: Migrate batch of components from Jest to Vitest
change_proposed: Migrate five packages/react test files (deprecated UnderlineNavLink, FilteredSearch, ActionList, SelectPanelLoading, SplitPageLayout) from Jest to Vitest by switching to vitest imports and @testing-library/react render, dropping behavesAsComponent/checkExports/axe tests, adding the files to vitest.config.mts (switched to jsdom) and excluding them from jest.config.js.
what_landed: All five files were migrated to Vitest within three weeks by maintainer-approved PRs: SplitPageLayout in #6310 (pksjce, 2025-07-10), UnderlineNavLink in #6335 (joshblack, 2025-07-22), and ActionList/FilteredSearch/SelectPanelLoading in #6354 (Copilot re-run of maintainer issue #6353, merged 2025-07-24); they registered the files in vitest.config.browser.mts (Playwright browser mode), not the node vitest.config.mts, kept the SplitPageLayout snapshot, and the SelectPanelLoading test kept querying the rendered live-region with vi timers without importing/registering LiveRegionElement.
closed_reason: Closed by maintainer joshblack after two change-request rounds (tests' meaning changed; live-region mocked); no reason stated. Same file list re-issued as #6353 with config target corrected to vitest.config.browser.mts.

title: Fix 7 critical bugs in php-leveldb extension
change_proposed: Seven defensive edits to leveldb.c: comparator error-path cleanup, nulling iterator->current after free, an extra db check before iterator destroy, an i < num_ranges bound in getApproximateSizes, a db null check in snapshot release, a local cache variable, and an early return when read options are NULL.
what_landed: Nothing landed: the only leveldb.c commit in the 180 days after closing is remicollet's PHP 8.5 exception-class fix (ba9344108a), and none of the seven edits appears.
closed_reason: Auto-closed by Devin after 7 days of inactivity; maintainer dktapps had called the changes pointless or redundant and not high severity.

title: Add pre-commit configuration and CI workflow
change_proposed: Add a .pre-commit-config.yaml (ending with check-yaml, check-added-large-files, codespell and a whitelist-empty hook), a GitHub Actions pre-commit workflow, pre-commit as a dev dependency, plus removal of ruff's output-format setting and spelling fixes.
what_landed: Maintainer adhami3310's #1656 (merged 2025-10-15) added a .pre-commit-config.yaml, a .github/workflows/pre-commit.yml running `pre-commit run --all-files`, and pre-commit as a dev dependency. Its hooks are only ruff-format and ruff --fix. None of this PR's hooks, its ruff-config edit or its .codespellrc/icon-tag edits landed.
closed_reason: Auto-closed by Devin for inactivity after the maintainer requested changes (objected to hardcoding words in .codespellrc).

change_proposed: Add a Polar.sh provider under alchemy/src/polar: an API client, Customer, Product, Subscription, Order, Meter, Benefit, Discount and Organization resources, docs, and live tests skipped in CI.

title: support per-record observations in batch listeners
change_proposed: Add an opt-in ContainerProperties.recordObservationsInBatch flag so that batch listeners create (via Observation.observe()) one observation per record before invoking the batch listener, plus docs and tests.
what_landed: Maintainer Soby Chacko merged the PR's commits by hand as 85b3aee ('GH-3944: support per-record observations in batch listeners' with docs updates and minor cleanup) on 2025-07-21; it is on main and the code is essentially identical to the PR.
closed_reason: Not declined: the maintainer merged it manually ('Merged via 85b3aee'), which GitHub shows as closed.

title: Upgrade goreleaser/goreleaser-action from v5 to v6
change_proposed: Bump goreleaser/goreleaser-action from v5 to v6 in ci.yml and release.yml, and migrate .goreleaser.yml to GoReleaser v2 (version: 2, snapshot.version_template), keeping the brews: section.

title: perf: improve hashing performance for manual path
change_proposed: Rewrite turborepo-scm's git_like_hash_file (manual.rs) to take the blob size from file metadata and stream the file through a hand-rolled 8KB buffer instead of read_to_end.
what_landed: Nothing landed: within 180 days manual.rs got only lint/format/edition commits and git_like_hash_file still used read_to_end; chunked 64KB hashing appeared only on 2026-04-06, about nine months later, in crlf.rs as part of a CRLF-normalization fix (#12572), outside the window and not this proposal.
closed_reason: Reviewer chris-olszewski asked for BufReader and a benchmark, doubting any speedup; the author anthonyshew closed it 'until we have real benchmarking'.

closed_reason: Superseded: the maintainer closed it in favor of his own PR #632.

title: Fix GUI security insights not appearing without running query commands
change_proposed: Add Query.populateAllNodeInsights() and call it in the GUI explorer, and make vlt query and vlt ls always load the security archive and pre-populate insights, so insights show up without security selectors.
what_landed: Maintainer ruyadorno's #990 (merged 2025-07-08, closing #788) made vlt query and vlt ls always load the security archive by removing the hasSecuritySelectors gate. populateAllNodeInsights() and the GUI pre-population never landed.
closed_reason: The reviewer disagreed with the direction: he wanted security data hydrated through a VSR endpoint during Graph loading, and saw this at best as an intermediate step. Closed without comment.

title: Replace npm with pnpm and poetry with uv
change_proposed: Switch the frontend from npm to pnpm and the Python side from Poetry to uv (pnpm-lock.yaml, uv.lock, uv-based pyproject, Makefile, CI workflow, Dockerfile and bump script updates).
what_landed: The maintainer did both migrations himself: npm to pnpm in #1932 (merged 2025-03-13) and Poetry to uv in #1936 (merged 2025-03-17, five hours before this PR was closed), with a PEP 621 [project]/[dependency-groups] pyproject, astral-sh/setup-uv and uv sync in CI; he deleted the Dockerfile rather than porting it, and #1970 later replaced the one remaining uv pip install with uv add --dev.
closed_reason: Closed by maintainer whitphx after review requests (no requirements.txt, use uv sync, use setup-uv, PEP 621 pyproject, no package.json edits); he had just merged his own pnpm (#1932) and uv (#1936) migrations.

title: Add GitHub Actions workflow for g++ and clang compilation

what_landed: Nothing within six months: no compiler-matrix workflow among the .github/workflows commits up to 2025-08-23. A different multi-compiler.yml (ubuntu-latest, g++ 11-13 and clang++ 14/15/17, `cat config.log`, no wolfSSL cache) was only added on 2026-03-04 in 09144d0c7a, about a year after closing.
